blind.description: An ornate dark bronze/brass floor candlestick supporting a thick ivory pillar candle. The base features small carved animal-paw feet, a twisted fluted stem with a central knop, and a shallow drip pan at the top. Sitting in the pan is a stylized cream-colored candle with melted wax running down the sides and a short black unlit wick on top.
blind.from_above: A concentric set of circles: the central dark wick point surrounded by the wavy melted wax top, the round lip of the metal drip plate, and four claw feet protruding radially at the base.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40-45% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 2 ft 4 in to 2 ft 6 in tall), with a base width of roughly 1 ft.

notes: base footprint slightly wider than catalog proportion
